idea: Week three, from the story bank: written from the source, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: Four pairs of states, one question each. Foreign tourist visits reported by states, 2024: West Bengal had one and a half times Rajasthan's. Foodgrains, 2024-25: Haryana grew over 80% more than Odisha. Bank credit to agriculture outstanding, March 2025: Kerala had just over double West Bengal's. Forest cover, India State of Forest Report 2023: Arunachal Pradesh had about 30% more than Maharashtra.
State totals, not per-person figures; pairs, not full rankings; the years differ by round. Each winner also led in the two years before.
source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States. Bank credit to agriculture outstanding, March 2025: Reserve Bank of India (Table 157). Forest cover, ISFR 2023: Forest Survey of India (Table 99, no normalisation factor). Foodgrains, 2024-25 final estimates: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare (Table 62). Foreign tourist visits reported by states, 2024: Ministry of Tourism (Table 182). State totals, not per person.

done: Every figure recomputed from the source by the writer and again by a numbers-and-rules editor, who also read the table notes; a viewer editor then reworked the round order and the closing question. Fixes applied before voicing: the credit round says bank credit (the table counts scheduled commercial banks only); questions are in the past tense for past years; rounds reordered to foreign tourist visits, foodgrains, bank credit, forest cover; pair order set so the winner alternates sides.
The first voiced build ran 48.8 seconds, over the 45-second limit. The spoken questions were shortened to drop the year (the year stays on screen in every round); the built length is now 43 seconds.
After the first render the closing question took three lines and ran into the tally; the heading now shrinks to keep to two lines.
